title: Ministers from EU, Black Sea, South Caucasus and Central Asia advance cooperation on cross-regional security and connectivity
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 16 Nov 2026 Today, the High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy/Vice-President of the European Commission Kaja Kallas, Commissioner for Enlargement Marta Kos, and Commissioner for International Partnerships Jozef Síkela hosted representatives from the EU, the Black Sea region, the South Caucasus and Central Asia for the second Ministerial Meeting on Cross-Regional Security and Connectivity in Brussels.
